name: ba-profile-generator
description: A tool for creating and sharing Blue Archive profile cards.

paragraphs: Blue Archive Profile Generator is a website that lets you create your own personal Blue Archive profile card that you can share with others on X via the #BlueArchiveProfile or #ブルアカプロフィール hashtags. You're also free to share your card on other social media services! It's a way to meet other fans of the series by sharing your progress, your favorite characters, and more. You can give it a try online via the following link!
